newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against both the dollar and the pound on Thursday, in line with international trends, commercial bank forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 20.5650 to the dollar from 20.6065 on Wednesday, and at 32.8565 to the pound from 32.9260.
Forex dealers said the central bank intervened again in the forex market at midday on Thursday, selling dollars at a rate slightly below the interbank forex market rate.
"With central bank intervention on Monday, Wednesday and today, banks are now square in their foreign exchange reserves," one dealer said.
